name: Echoform Tape Mode - Window Size Scaling
description: Validates tape window parameter (0-30s range) affects jump behavior - larger windows = larger jump distances

full_response.description: Full response - captures behavior with 15s window (0.5 normalized × 30s max)

initial_hold.description: Initial hold period before first jump

active_jumping.description: Active jumping phase - multiple jump cycles

moderate_variance.description: RMS variance should indicate stochastic behavior (larger window = more variation possible)

smooth_slew.description: 0.25s slew should create smooth transitions despite larger window

feedback_stability.description: Tape mode uses fixed 0.65 feedback - should be stable

use_cases: Verify tape window parameter affects jump range
Validate jump ratios within window (near: 0.7-1.0×, deep: 0.25-0.9×)
Ensure larger windows create larger absolute jump distances
Check slew time remains constant (0.25s) regardless of window size
pass_criteria: Output shows stochastic jumping behavior with spectral variation, smooth transitions, stable feedback, and deterministic operation with fixed seed
example_failures: No spectral variation → jumps not reaching different tape positions
Excessive discontinuities → slew not scaling correctly
Window size not affecting behavior → parameter not applied
Unstable feedback → fixed 0.65 feedback not working
